concerns.text: T037 raises a FATAL RuntimeError if real data is missing and forbids automatic fallback, while T037b is manual-only. This violates the Plan's 'Adaptive Model Selection' strategy (Case A: Missing Data -> Synthetic Generator) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility). The pipeline cannot execute in a fresh CI environment without real data, creating a deadlock where SC-005 (valid sample count) cannot be produced.

Circular dependency: T025a (Merge Features) depends on T022c (Mahalanobis), which depends on T027d (Model Selection). However, T027d (Model Selection) requires T025a to have run to provide features for the logic. T025a cannot run until T027d runs, but T027d cannot run until T025a runs. This breaks the producer-consumer flow.

T022b computes Global Covariance on the *entire* aligned dataset (pre-filter), but T022c (Mahalanobis) and T025a depend on `data/processed/cleaned_data.parquet` (post-filter). The tasks do not define how to align the global covariance matrix (computed on N samples) with the per-sample Mahalanobis distance calculation (which requires the mean/cov of the same N samples used for the distance), risking a mathematical inconsistency if T024 removes samples used for T022b.

T014 states: 'Use the value of the column `primary_dimension` if present. If missing... set to null'. This contradicts the Spec/Plan requirement (FR-003, SC-004) that the primary dimension MUST be determined by a fixed schema rule/metadata independent of model scores. Relying on a column that may be missing leaves the target variable undefined, failing the independence verification.

T030c requires a paired t-test on residuals, but T028 (CV) and T029 (Evaluation) do not explicitly output the residuals artifact. The task chain assumes residuals are available in memory or a shared state not defined as an artifact, risking a 'missing artifact' failure for the t-test verification.
